description: Report where this organisation stands in Aeroz onboarding: current stage, percentage complete, health, the single next action, and every open step with which side owns it. Use this to answer "what do we still need to do", "why are we not live yet", or "what is Aeroz waiting on". Steps marked side="aeroz" are Aeroz's obligation, not the customer's — say so plainly rather than presenting them as homework.
name: onboarding_status
title: Onboarding status
